gpuhint.copied: Copied. Paste it into a new tab.
gpuhint.copyFailed: Could not copy. Select the address and copy it.
gpuhint.fixFlag: Fastest, in the browser: open this address in a new tab, choose Enabled, then press Relaunch:
gpuhint.fixWindows: Or in Windows: open the graphics settings (Settings, System, Display, Graphics), add this browser to the list if it is not there, choose High performance for it, then close every window of the browser and start it again.
gpuhint.softFixBrowser: Graphics acceleration is switched off in the browser. Open this address in a new tab, switch graphics (hardware) acceleration on, and restart the browser:
gpuhint.softFixDriver: Or the graphics driver is disabled or missing, so the browser has no graphics card to draw on.
gpuhint.softFixDriverWindows: In Windows open Device Manager, Display adapters: every adapter must be enabled and have its driver. On a laptop a disabled built-in adapter (Intel) can leave the browser with no graphics card at all, even when there is an NVIDIA card: enable it again.
gpuhint.softText: The browser is drawing this page on the processor ({name}), not on a graphics card, so the scan runs very slowly. This usually has one of two causes:
gpuhint.text: This page is drawing on the integrated graphics chip ({name}). If this computer also has an NVIDIA or AMD graphics card, the browser is not using it: on Windows the browser picks the card, not the page, and it ignores the page's request for the faster one. To switch:
gpuhint.textBack: This page is drawing on the integrated graphics chip ({name}) again. Earlier this browser used the faster graphics card: an update of the browser or of Windows can reset that choice. To switch back:
gpuhint.warn.back: This browser used the faster graphics card before.
gpuhint.warn.software: The browser draws on the processor, not on a graphics card.
gpuhint.warn.switch: A faster graphics card may be sitting unused.
